definitions.gloss: wild beast; ferocious animal; beast of prey
definitions.explanation: A large, dangerous animal such as a lion, tiger, or bear. Used in contexts involving zoos, wildlife, and figurative descriptions of fierceness.

examples.japanese: {猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{檻|おり}→檻：28564_ori⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: A wild beast escaped from its cage at the zoo.

examples.japanese: {猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Keeping wild beasts requires special permits and facilities.

notes:
{猛獣|もうじゅう} refers to large, dangerous animals such as lions, tigers, bears, and other powerful predators. It does not apply to small or harmless wild animals.

FORMS:
{猛|もう} (fierce, violent) + {獣|じゅう} (beast). The character {猛|もう} also appears in ⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧ (fierce), ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (intense heat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦{使|つか}い→使い：25633_tsukai⟧: animal tamer (circus/show)
- {猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be attacked by a wild beast
- {猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{檻|おり}→檻：28564_ori⟧: cage for dangerous animals
- {猛獣|もうじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: beware of dangerous animals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猛獣|もうじゅう}: ferocious/dangerous animal
- ⟦{野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧: wild animal (any species)
- ⟦{害獣|がいじゅう}→害獣：24662_gaijuu⟧: pest animal (causing damage to crops, etc.)
